The poor orphan niece (Deanna Durbin) of a tycoon (Eugene Pallette) goes to a ball and meets a rich boyfriend (Robert Stack).
programme.title: First Love

programme.desc: Two vaudeville guys (Bing Crosby, Bob Hope) turn deep-sea divers and save a treasure belonging to a Polynesian princess (Dorothy Lamour).
programme.title: Road to Bali

programme.desc: A poor but hopeful boy seeks one of the five coveted golden tickets that will send him on a tour of Willy Wonka's mysterious chocolate factory.
programme.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory

programme.desc: An astronaut and his team crash on a world ruled by intelligent, talking simians who treat humans like animals.
programme.title: Planet of the Apes

programme.desc: A ballet dancer (Vivien Leigh) and a British officer (Robert Taylor) cross stars on the eve of World War I.
programme.title: Waterloo Bridge

programme.desc: Brigham Young (Maurice Grandmaison) and a Mormon group face persecution as they look to settle.
programme.title: Savage Journey

programme.desc: A folksy New England poet (Gary Cooper) inherits $20 million he doesn't want and tells a New York newswoman (Jean Arthur) why.
programme.title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town

programme.desc: A playboy novelist's (Kirk Douglas) most businesslike secretary (Laraine Day) becomes his wife and literary rival.
programme.title: My Dear Secretary

programme.desc: Corrupt Russian officials mistake a traveling buffoon (Danny Kaye) for the czar's dreaded inspector general.
programme.title: The Inspector General

programme.desc: A snooty socialite (Katharine Hepburn) fights with her ex-husband (Cary Grant) and flirts with a reporter (James Stewart).
programme.title: The Philadelphia Story

programme.desc: Two brothers (Spencer Tracy, Robert Wagner) climb to a plane crash in the Alps: one to help, the other to loot.
programme.title: The Mountain

programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Gene Autry) saves a señorita (Elena Verdugo) from a former rodeo star (Stephen Dunne) who likes her big ranch.
programme.title: The Big Sombrero

programme.desc: A Greek slave (Victor Mature) entrusted with Christ's robe must play gladiator for Emperor Caligula and Messalina.
programme.title: Demetrius and the Gladiators

programme.desc: A cartoonist (Dean Martin) turns his babbling roommate's (Jerry Lewis) bizarre dreams into a hit comic strip read by spies.
programme.title: Artists and Models

programme.desc: S01 E05 — A Time to Kill The son of a dead man accused of a stage coach robbery finds an empty strongbox in the attic and hopes that Jim Hardie can help him uncover the real thieves.
programme.title: Tales of Wells Fargo

programme.desc: A screenwriter (William Holden) daydreams with his new secretary (Audrey Hepburn) in Paris instead of meeting a producer's (Noel Coward) deadline.
programme.title: Paris When It Sizzles

programme.desc: A rich Virginia farmer (James Stewart) stays out of the Civil War, then joins it to protect his family.
programme.title: Shenandoah

programme.desc: Blondie (Penny Singleton) and Dagwood (Arthur Lake) send Baby Dumpling (Larry Simms) to military school, then go back to college.
programme.title: Blondie Goes to College

programme.desc: A Scotland Yard inspector (Byron Palmer) follows an actress (Constance Smith) to her fellow lodger, Jack the Ripper (Jack Palance).
programme.title: Man in the Attic

programme.desc: A surgeon (Paul Lukather) transplants a murdered man's hands to a concert pianist (James Stapleton) and the hands begin to drive him mad.
programme.title: Hands of a Stranger

programme.desc: Mickey Spillane's private eye Mike Hammer follows bad guys and blondes to a smoking box.
programme.title: Kiss Me Deadly

programme.desc: A mad professor (Boris Karloff) in New England zaps people in a special cabinet to create an army of supermen.
programme.title: The Boogie Man Will Get You

programme.desc: A busboy is embraced by the beatnik art community when he develops an impressive but morbid method of sculpturing.
programme.title: A Bucket of Blood

programme.desc: Herman (Fred Gwynne), Lily (Yvonne De Carlo), Grandpa (Al Lewis) and their ghoulish TV family go to England to claim an estate.
programme.title: Munster, Go Home

programme.desc: A San Francisco playgirl (Tippi Hedren) follows a bachelor (Rod Taylor) to Bodega Bay where, for no apparent reason, flocks of birds begin killing the populace.
programme.title: The Birds

programme.desc: Baron Frankenstein creates a monster from cadavers and a killer's brain.
programme.title: Frankenstein
